name: advocacy-readiness-grader
description: Employee-advocacy readiness grader: collects public evidence (robots, sitemaps, sampled pages, careers surface) for any domain and scores it with a deterministic rubric. The report is the product; the letter grade is withheld whenever classification coverage does not earn it.
